patterns.label: Cold open
patterns.detail: One-line hook first: a question ('Where does SpaceX find $400 billion?'), a shout ('Holy shit.', 'THIS IS F*CKING INSANE', '🚨 BREAKING'), or a flat claim. Story comes after the line break.

patterns.label: Numbered stack / stat block
patterns.detail: Fleet math (970 total, 463 Cybercabs, +78%), GW/GPU breakdowns, prediction scorecards (6 right, 2 wrong, 7 open), 'X repos / 7 prompts' lists, arrow lists.

patterns.label: Named tools and models
patterns.detail: Fable 5.5, Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Terra, Codex, Claude Duet, Grok Bot, Hermes, Muse, Nanbeige4.3-33B, Kimi K3.1, FSD v14.3 Lite, Cybercab, Roadster. Named product in the first 2 lines.

patterns.label: Soft CTA question
patterns.detail: Close with a low-effort question: 'Will it get there before November 1st?', 'Which one would you go for?', 'what's the most surprising story here?'

patterns.label: Versus framing
patterns.detail: Tesla vs Waymo at Austin F1, Kimi vs Claude, human vs Figure 03 robot, Roadster vs Lamborghini, Grok Build vs Claude Code.

patterns.label: Quote-post riff
patterns.detail: 22 of 46 watchlist hits are quote posts: add a one-line take on top of someone else's news or clip.

patterns.label: Media mix
patterns.detail: Watchlist hits: 26 photo, 9 video, 11 text-only. Outsiders lean text (11 of 20). Photo plus short caption is the default winner.

patterns.label: Posting window
patterns.detail: Most hits posted 07:00-13:00 PT (28 of 46). Late-night PT (00:00-02:00) produced the two biggest AI posts (143K, 76K).

patterns.label: Ticker tag
patterns.detail: Finance-adjacent Tesla/SpaceX posts end with a cashtag ($SPCX, $TSLA).
